value.title: Sandbox attribution: detect, commit safely, recover
value.validated_in_sandbox: 2026-08-07 — assets/validations/ (both branches proven live under a real Seatbelt block)

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Agent command sandboxes (Cursor/Seatbelt today; any unix-socket-blocking sandbox by the same mechanism) silently sever git-ai's only ingress — the trace2 commit event — so commits land with no attribution and the recovery ladder re-attests AI work as known-human. A 7-run controlled investigation (assets/research-dossier.md) proved the failure is command-shape dependent AND non-deterministic across sessions, so no IDE configuration is reliable. This plan ships the lean harness response inside PR #104: a probe-backed doctor verdict that tells the truth when the collector cannot see, an at-risk enumeration of unattributed commits, the capture-liveness green-forever fix, a 'harness commit' entrypoint that commits safely and verifies attribution landed, a 'harness doctor telemetry-nudge' recovery verb that replays buffered trace2 events, and CLI-shipped agent guidance. Node builtins only; every new test CI-achievable via fake ports.

sections.name: goals
value: Harness tells the truth when the collector cannot see: a probe-backed ingress verdict and an honest at-risk list, warn-never-block
Agents have a commit path that cannot silently lose attribution: harness commit with verify-after-commit
Lost commit events are recoverable where possible: telemetry-nudge replays buffered trace2 into the collector
Guidance ships inside the CLI and reaches consuming repos through existing seams, never hand-edits
Everything lands additively in PR #104 on s073/gitai-collector-v1

sections.name: non_goals
value: No git-ai patches, forks, or upstream issue filings (standing instruction)
No sandbox detection beyond the ingress probe: env markers never produce a verdict
No guarantee of retroactive recovery: nudge is best-effort v1, replay-what-is-buffered; the transcript-sweep wake (F-09) is recorded as observed, not relied on (U-1)
No Cursor-side configuration shipped or required (allowlist/sandbox.json are documented user options only)

No Windows sandbox support: Windows is must-not-break, not must-work (U-5). CORRECTED by plan 075: this plan shipped NO platform guard — `win32`/`process.platform` appeared nowhere in ingress.ts, nudge.ts or commit-service.ts, and a Windows named pipe was in fact MISCLASSIFIED as a drainable file buffer. The guarded no-op became true in plan 075, not here.
No new or external dependencies; no CI test may need a daemon, real socket, or sandbox

value.claim: A SocketProbePort exists as a CLI port with a node:net real adapter (bounded timeout <=1s, connects and destroys, never sends a byte). The probe classifies connected | denied | refused | absent | timeout | error:<code> (every outcome the proven prototype emits), and the resolver above it yields unconfigured (no trace2 target) and file (target is a plain path) without probing. CI tests drive a fake port through every outcome including timeout and error; the real adapter's classification mapping is additionally covered by injected-socket unit tests that need no daemon; the real adapter itself is never exercised in CI.

The collector health read gains an ingress-blocked verdict: probe returns denied while the socket file exists. It renders as a warning, never a block (073 ac-000c holds). Sandbox environment markers (CURSOR_SANDBOX etc.) may appear in the warning text to explain a blocked probe but can never produce or influence the verdict: a test asserts markers-present + probe-connected yields no warning.

Doctor enumerates at-risk commits: commits on the current branch with no refs/notes/ai entry, newest first, windowed to commits ahead of merge-base(HEAD, origin/<default-branch>) and capped at 200; when no upstream/merge-base exists the fallback is the last 50 commits, and the output names which window rule applied. The wording says unattributed and never claims AI authorship. An empty list under a blocked or unprobeable ingress reports as unproven, never clean, asserted by test.

capture-liveness no longer reports green when capture is disabled: the check is gated on capture being enabled, otherwise reporting could-not-determine (or equivalent honest verdict). Its green-forever failure mode (doctor-service.ts:25,755) is dead, proven by a test that runs doctor on a default (capture-off) install and asserts the check does not report healthy.

A harness commit entrypoint exists (single command, execFile only, no shell interpolation). It resolves+probes the ingress first and the branch partition is EXHAUSTIVE over every ac-0001 outcome: connected -> commit with NO trace2 override, then bounded verify that a refs/notes/ai note landed (verify-miss never rolls back or blocks; degraded envelope). file -> commit with no override (the configured target already buffers), then degraded envelope naming that file as the nudge's buffer. EVERY other outcome (denied | refused | absent | timeout | error:<code> | unconfigured) -> commit with GIT_TRACE2_EVENT pointed at a buffer file under the gitignored harness temp dir, degraded envelope naming the buffer and the telemetry-nudge verb, note-verify skipped (delivery deferred by design). The connected and buffered branches are mutually exclusive because the env var REPLACES the socket target. CI tests drive fake probe/git/fs ports through EVERY outcome, one test per outcome.

A harness doctor telemetry-nudge verb recovers buffered trace2 events safely: it ROTATES the live buffer first (rename to a timestamped segment; appenders never race a truncation), replays the whole segment into the collector socket via node:net, re-reads refs/notes/ai, and deletes the segment ONLY when EVERY commit SHA named in that segment's events now carries a note — a partially-confirmed segment is RETAINED intact (no partial file rewrite) and reported. Because duplicate-replay semantics against the daemon are unproven (U-3), v1 never automatically re-replays a retained segment: retained segments are listed with an explicit retry instruction, and automatic retry is deferred until the tk-000b spike establishes duplicate behavior. Honest recovered/still-missing/retained counts; never fails the doctor run; graceful no-op on no-buffer/no-socket/non-af_unix. CI: fake socket + fake fs through rotate/replay/all-confirm-delete/partial-retain; live daemon is the spike, never CI.

Doctor and checks stay READ-ONLY on the collector: when unattributed commits exist they DETECT and report, and their next_action names the exact recovery command (harness doctor telemetry-nudge) — but the nudge itself runs only when explicitly invoked; no bare doctor or checks run ever mutates a socket, buffer, or ref. Asserted with fakes at the doctor-service level: detection present, mutation absent.

Placement decision (recorded): harness commit and telemetry-nudge are CORE CLI verbs. Commit guidance ships inside the CLI at two named seams: (1) the instructions surface — which today resolves only extension-registry verbs — is extended with a CORE-page registration so 'harness instructions commit' resolves the core page, covered by a test that resolves it; the page states the safe shapes and their honest guarantee: a harness commit is VERIFIED and never silently lost (buffered + named for recovery when the ingress is blocked), while chained/compound git commits can silently lose attribution; (2) the AGENTS.md managed block (fenced markers, idempotent inject/refresh through the existing adopt/inject guidance seam) carrying the same line. The doctor warning and the harness commit degraded envelope both point at the instructions page. Doctor warns when the block is absent and never edits files silently. The guidance never claims guaranteed delivery for any shape.

Documentation: docs/how/gitai-collector.md gains a self-contained sandbox-attribution section — a sanitized synthesis (the failure mode, the probe verdict, the two safe commit shapes, the nudge), not a link-dump into plan research. check:docs passes and the warn-launch baseline does not grow: arch-check 2, markdown-lint 196, windows-check 6 (recorded 2026-08-07).

Constraint AC: the diff introduces no new production dependency (node builtins only), no new test may require a running git-ai daemon, real socket, sandbox, or network, and the 073 shipped surface changes only additively (new verdicts, new verbs, new port). Proven by dependency diff + CI green.

value.title: Phase 1: Implementation
value.brief: All six features, one phase (Simple mode): detection (probe port, verdict, at-risk, liveness fix), action (harness commit, telemetry-nudge), guidance + docs.
